interview.name: Uli
interview.answer: The start time and location haven’t been confirmed yet; Uli is still waiting on that information.

reflections: Uli is willing to help, but needs the interaction to stay low-key.
Oren responds supportively and makes room for limited help without pressure.
Ira is dependable and proactive, offering to watch for updates and relay them promptly.
Uli is willing to help, but prefers keeping things low-key and needs practical flexibility.
Ira and Quinn are responsive coordinators who help spread information and keep the repair-drive logistics moving.
The group is collaborative and reassuring, with several people offering small but useful forms of support.
Uli is the main coordinator for the repair drive and is being asked for schedules, location, and priorities.
Quinn is helping organize outreach and invite lists, and Uli is feeding them priorities to spread around.
Several people want clearer logistics, so Uli is becoming the point person for updates while keeping things low-key.
Uli is the main coordinator and information source for the repair drive, but they are still waiting on basic logistics like start time and location.
The others are being helpful in complementary ways: Vik is spreading the word and Oren is preparing supplies.
Communication is cautious and somewhat fragmented, so people are asking to be kept updated and to share the plan quietly once details are confirmed.
Uli is coordinating logistics and often shares updates for the repair drive, while others look to them for the latest schedule and what to bring.
Vik and Rey are helping by spreading the word and recruiting volunteers, suggesting a shared support role around the event.
Noah seems uncertain about the details but is willing to contribute once the schedule and supply list are confirmed.

events.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Oren: That’s alright, Uli — low-key helps just fine. If you can spare even a little, I’d really appreciate it.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that a lot.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Ira: Of course — if I hear any news, I’ll pass it along right away.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Tess: No worries at all — even a little help counts. If you change your mind, I can still bring the tool kit and keep it easy-going.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Uli: I can coordinate around school pickup times if that would make the repair drive easier. What do you need from me?
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Quinn: I’m still gathering the repair-drive details, and I can put you on the invite list too. If you know what needs fixing first, send it my way and I’ll spread it around.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I can send over a few low-key priorities later today.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Quinn: Perfect — send them when you can, and I’ll get the invite list moving too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — could you confirm the start time and the location for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Uli: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — I’m still waiting on the start time and location, so please let me know if you hear anything.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Vik: That’d help a lot—could you let me know the latest schedule and whether there’s anything I should bring? I’m still getting the updates second-hand.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Uli: I can check the latest schedule and send it over. If you can bring a few basic tools or work gloves, that’d be helpful, but please keep it quiet today.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Uli: I’m still checking on the start time and location for the repair drive. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli — just let me know when you hear back. I’m ready to help gather tools, tape, batteries, and spare parts once we’ve got the details.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: Sounds good — I’ll let you know as soon as I get the time and place.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Uli: I can check the latest schedule and send it over. If anything’s needed, I’ll let you know what to bring.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and repeat the plan if anyone asks.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll pass along the latest schedule as soon as I have it.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Noah: Got it — Sunday at the community center works. What should I bring, if anything?
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Uli: I’m still trying to keep up—what’s the latest on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Noah: I’m not totally sure either, but I think it’s still set for Sunday at the community center. If you hear the supply list, let me know and I’ll bring something.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Rey: Thanks for the update—Sunday at the community center works for me. What still needs doing?
events.speaker: Rey

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Uli: I can help with setup around school pickup times if that makes Sunday easier. Do you want me to handle signs, tables, or checking in volunteers?
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rey: I’m a bit late, but I can help spread the word and round up a volunteer or two for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Rey

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
